name: Harrow's Barrow
description: The burial barrow of the old lord of Harrowmere, four floors of cold earth and cut stone, whose dead have not stayed put.

b1_entry.name: The Barrow Mouth
b1_entry.description: A stair comes down into a low, damp chamber that stinks of old earth. A passage runs north into the dark.

b1_gallery.name: The Gallery of Niches
b1_gallery.description: A long gallery whose walls are pierced with shelves for the dead. Most of the shelves are empty now.

b1_cell.name: The Mourners' Cell
b1_cell.description: A narrow cell with a stone bench and a chest, tucked away from the main way.

b1_hall.name: The Hall of Lamps
b1_hall.description: A hall of broken lamp-stands, with a chest under the dust and a door of old oak in its south-east corner.

southeast.failure_message: The oak door in the corner is locked. A brass key would answer it.

b1_vault.name: The Keepers' Vault
b1_vault.description: A little vault behind a locked door, with a chest whose lid has not been lifted in a lifetime.

b1_stair.name: The Stair Down
b1_stair.description: A steep, ruined stair going down into the cold.

b2_landing.name: The Second Landing
b2_landing.description: The stair ends in a damp landing, floored with fallen plaster.

b2_cross.name: The Bone Crossing
b2_cross.description: Four passages meet over a floor strewn with small, pale bones.

b2_ossuary.name: The Ossuary
b2_ossuary.description: A chamber stacked to the ceiling with skulls, neatly, by a careful hand.

b2_pit.name: The Dry Well
b2_pit.description: A round chamber with a dry well in the middle. The echo is wrong.

b2_stair.name: The Deeper Stair
b2_stair.description: A narrow stair, slick with seeping water.

b3_landing.name: The Third Landing
b3_landing.description: A cold landing. The walls here are not stone but packed, pale clay.

b3_gallery.name: The Long Crypt
b3_gallery.description: A crypt longer than it is wide, lined with sealed tombs.

b3_circlet.name: The Dark Alcove
b3_circlet.description: A small alcove, colder than the rest. A black coffer sits on a stone shelf.

b3_sanctum.name: The Harper's Rest
b3_sanctum.description: A round chamber hung with the rags of old tapestries. A narrow silver-bound chest sits where an altar should be.

b3_side.name: The Collapsed Gallery
b3_side.description: A gallery half-choked with fallen stone; a way squeezes through.

b3_stair.name: The Lowest Stair
b3_stair.description: The last stair, a dozen steps of black stone.

b4_landing.name: The Last Landing
b4_landing.description: A landing of black stone, bare as a swept hearth.

b4_hall.name: The Silent Hall
b4_hall.description: A long hall without a single carving. Your footsteps seem to arrive before you do.

b4_ward.name: The Empty Ward
b4_ward.description: A small chamber with an empty niche, long robbed.

b4_end.name: The End of the Barrow
b4_end.description: A dead end, with a smooth wall. There is nothing here but the silence, and the feeling of being watched.
